name: Rovaniemi in a day
description_md:
Rovaniemi in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in Finland. The day is anchored in Rovaniemi and features six sightseeing stops.

The distance of the walking between the stops is 8.3 km. The full day takes about 7.5 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
